The manuscript develops the gap law, regular deflation, complete theta-tail bounds, and the conditional survival theorem in proof order. It then derives the unsigned redundancy test and the Lehmer force-bound direction, checks them against exact heat-polynomial controls, and presents the inherited numerical certificates as supporting evidence for the two case decisions.

The closing section identifies what remains open: certifying a useful pair at a specified positive starting time, finding a concrete gain over a matched direct comparison, and establishing the factor floor, confinement, and signed upper-force margins.
